verdict.rationale: Kick documents no native scheduler for recurring jobs or workflows. Rules are event-triggered: they run whenever a matching transaction syncs, not on a time-based schedule. The 'automate month-end checks' language describes using MCP/CLI from external AI tools, which is a developer building block or user-side workaround, not a product-provided recurring schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
